layouts.name: Kartodromo Fatima
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The operator park plan identifies the full course through the northeastern dogleg and the complete southwestern hairpin, excluding the two shorter bypasses and the northern training loop. The exact independent source-node route measures 1092.9 m. The catalogue scalar of 2041 m is retained separately; neither the course geometry nor its measured length is adjusted to it. Historical alignment remains a draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1092.9 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
